background_story: Sloan was a skilled woodworker with a passion for traditional craftsmanship. Growing up in a family of carpenters, he learned the art of working with wood from a young age. Sloan's specialty was creating intricate lathwork, weaving thin strips of wood into beautiful and functional pieces of art. His workshop was filled with the sweet scent of freshly cut wood and the soft glow of lanterns. As a master of his craft, Sloan was commissioned to restore the historic lath ceiling of a centuries-old church. With precision and patience, he carefully wove new lath strips into the existing framework, bringing the ancient structure back to its former glory. Sloan's dedication to his craft and attention to detail earned him a reputation as one of the finest woodworkers in the region.
